Needs changes before merge.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/tests/golden/sketch_engrave_trace.cl:1`: Add a `Goldens moved` section to the PR body. List this new CL file. Keep the existing explanation of its 18 moves. Reply after the body edit so this head can be reviewed again. The recorded-program rule requires the file entry before merge.

Local results:

The tests used `.claude/worktrees/review-3458`. The trial merge used upstream/main 69997a6ded2d6ca559601c9233629045caabecda. Its first parent is the PR head above.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 813 steps passed; 7,693 tests passed; 115 ignored; 0 failed |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | Build and both light twins passed; 3 steps; 0 failed |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | 252 steps passed; 110 tests passed; 4 registered expected failures matched; 0 gate failures |
| Strict Clippy | All app and motion targets passed with `-D warnings` |
| Extra probes | 4 passed; 0 failed |

heavy lanes green on 2032dda7e06f100d1a2ddc9caa53a4fc8ae2c162: 252 steps, 0 failed. Base: upstream/main 69997a6ded2d6ca559601c9233629045caabecda (2026-11-23T00:19:53+01:00). The registered failures are tracked by #1950 and #2849.

The upstream/main ref advanced during this run. These results apply to the trial-merge base named above.

Extra suites run:

- `example_catalog`: 37 passed and 4 ignored in quick. The heavy result above covers its ignored cases.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- All mapped consumers of `crates/app/tests/golden/` ran in quick. This includes the app suites, post consumers, and `cl::headless_bin`.
- `sketch_engrave_trace`: all 11 tests passed. They cover geometry, stock depth, stock breakthrough, rapids, fixtures, crossings, project storage, MCP, and posting.

Safety checks:

I checked all 20 lines of the new CL golden. The arc centers, directions, and clearance lifts match the fixture.

I ran two output mutations in memory with the PR's assertions. A 1 mm arc-center error failed the geometry assertion. A transfer at Z5.5 failed the clearance assertion. The original paths passed both checks. The probes and mutation harness stayed in `/tmp`.

The tilt probes reached the existing named DXF refusal before generation. The final checks confirm this refusal for Engrave and Trace. The source stamp includes the sketch geometry and world pose for whole profiles and selected chains.

Non-blocking note: `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs` grows from 557 to 568 lines under the **400-line files** rule.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The PR body now has the `Goldens moved` section. It lists the new file `crates/app/tests/golden/sketch_engrave_trace.cl` as a new recorded CL file. No existing golden moves. The explanation of the 18 moves stays in the body.

The head is unchanged at `2032dda7e`. Ready for a re-check.

Merge state against main now: `mergeable` is false and `mergeable_state` is dirty. One file conflicts: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs`. The branch takes main at merge time, by the rule "Refresh only at merge time".

This PR goes back to draft. The merge of main needs one hand edit. The file crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs had a conflict. Both sides added a pub use line. I keep both lines. I will push, gate, and ask for a re-check.

I merged main into this branch. The new head is e42e54249.

The only conflict was in crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs. Both sides added one pub use line. Main added slot_centre_band. This PR added TraceStrokes. I kept both lines. No other file needed a hand edit.

The delta class is DELTA, because of the one hand-resolved file. Please review only the remerge-diff of e42e54249.

Gate on the new head:
- motion build, motion lib (slow test noted) and motion slot_round_ends: pass.
- app lib: 303 passed, 0 failed.
- app suites sketch_engrave_trace (11), engrave_law (10), mark_floor (7), contour_dxf_sketch (4), slot_dxf_sketch (5), sketch_profile (8): all pass, 0 failed.
- The full quick plan selects about 800 steps, because the golden file sketch_engrave_trace.cl is a shared input. I did not run it. The disk was full. The gate readings in the PR body are for head 2032dda7e. They are not renewed.
- Clippy and the heavy lanes were not run on this head.

The PR stays a draft until the delta review. Ready for a re-check.

The quick gate is now complete on head e42e54249.

- Full quick plan against `origin/main`: 847 steps. One step failed on the first run: `app suites: example_catalog`. The test `catalog_3d_rough_finish::rebuilds` passed its 60 s case limit by 0.11 s, at a load average of about 130.
- A re-run of that step at normal load passed in 28 s, with 0 failed.
- The light lane is green.
- The branch merges cleanly with `origin/main` 09ad779ee.

The PR body has a new section with these readings. The delta class is DELTA: please review the remerge-diff of e42e54249. The `Goldens moved` section is in the body, as requested in the review on 2032dda7e.

I mark this PR ready now.
